messages:
Ana (PM): FYI — AcmeCorp delivered a tightened SOC2+ISO checklist and is asking for finer-grained retention and a BYOK handshake timeline. Can we map this into next quarter's roadmap?
Cody (Eng): Quick question — when you say 'finer-grained retention' do they mean per-tenant TTLs or event-level retention rules?
Ana (PM): They called out three things: 1) per-tenant retention presets (e.g., 90/365/indefinite), 2) ability to mark certain events as 'sensitive' and auto-shorten retention, 3) audit export format that links to KMS-wrapped artifacts.
Lina (Security): From a compliance POV we need: immutable evidence pointers, retention proof (hashing), and an auditable BYOK handshake. Also want a clear SLA for audit-search before we promise customers retrieval windows.
Mike (SRE): Operational constraint: our cold-archive ingestion path adds ~24-48h retrieval. If we promise sub-hour audit-search for recent windows we must be explicit about warm vs cold tiers.
Cody (Eng): Proposal for roadmap scoping: P0: Audit-search SLA for last 90 days (warm index + fast path). P1: Per-tenant retention presets + UI. P2: BYOK handshake + export spec (KMS metadata). P3: Event-level sensitivity tagging and auto-shortening.
Sara (Legal): We also need export metadata to include custody chain and key IDs for legal discovery. Suggest we standardize an evidence manifest: {hash, key_id, created_by, retention_policy}.
Ana (PM): Good note — add evidence manifest to acceptance criteria. Also AcmeCorp wants a timeline: can we commit to a pilot for P0+P1 in 8 weeks?
Cody (Eng): 8 weeks is tight but feasible if we limit pilot scope: warm-index only (no cold read path), and limited to 3 tenants. Implementation notes: index metadata needs tenant_id, event_type, timestamp, retention_tier, evidence_pointer. Example manifest format we can accept:
```
{
  "hash": "sha256:...",
  "key_id": "projects/acme/kms/keys/…",
  "created_by": "redwood-ingest/23",
  "retention_policy": "90d",
  "evidence_pointer": "s3://audit-bucket/…"
}
```
Lina (Security): FYI: key_id should reference our KMS canonical format; avoid customer-local URIs in manifests — map to canonical IDs in the control plane. Also we need an HSM/KMS escrow procedure documented for SOC2 auditors.
Mike (SRE): For pilot infra: allocate warm shards + dedicated query nodes for audit-search. We'll need an autoscale guardrail and a cost estimate. Cody — can you draft infra delta and perf targets (p99 < 700ms for warm queries)?
Cody (Eng): Yep — will draft a spec. Quick draft acceptance criteria for pilot: 
- Warm audit-search (90d) p99 < 700ms for queries scoped to tenant/time/event-type.
- Retention presets available in console and via API (90/365/indefinite).
- Evidence manifest included in export and tied to KMS key_id.
- Pilot limited to 3 enterprise tenants, RBAC controls enforced.
Ana (PM): Sara/Lina — if we deliver pilot, will that unblock AcmeCorp demo/commit?
Lina (Security): Demo ok for initial compliance sign-off, but full SOC2 evidence package requires BYOK escrow + immutable retention proofs. That can be phase 2.
Sara (Legal): Agree — pilot suffices for contract milestone if we document limitations. Add legal checklist item: export retention caveats + escrow terms.
ops-bot: New task created — PRODUCT-4982: Pilot: Warm audit-search + retention presets (assignee: Cody). Due date: 2026-05-15.
Ana (PM): Next steps — Cody to post detailed spec by EOD Friday; Mike to sketch infra cost and scaling notes; Lina/Sara to list audit artifacts we must ship in phase 2. I'll update roadmap and send timeline to Acme. :thumbsup:
Cody (Eng): Will do. Posting spec to #product in a follow-up thread.
Mike (SRE): I'll add the autoscale and retrieval-backpressure options to the doc.
Lina (Security): I'll flush out the escrow protocol and required logs for evidence proofs.
Sara (Legal): I'll prepare a short contract addendum template for pilot limitations.
Ana (PM): Thanks everyone — closing this thread and moving the action items to the ticket.
